items.example: The small village was hit by a terrible flood last summer, and many houses were destroyed.（這個小村莊去年夏天遭遇了嚴重的水災，許多房屋都被摧毀了。）
The baker down the street makes the most delicious croissants in the neighbourhood.（街尾的這位烘焙師做的可頌是附近最好吃的。）
We need to replace our old cooker because the oven doesn’t work anymore.（我們得更換舊廚灶了，因為烤箱已經壞了。）
She will sign a contract with the design firm next Monday and start working there in May.（她下週一將與這家設計公司簽訂合約，五月開始在那裡工作。）
Our company will hold its annual meeting in April this year, in a hotel near the city centre.（我們公司今年四月將在市中心附近的飯店舉行年度大會。）
The students have made great progress in their English speaking skills after three months of practice.（經過三個月的練習，這些學生的英語口語能力有了極大的進步。）
I usually do the laundry on Sunday mornings and hang the clothes out to dry in the sun.（我通常在周日早上洗衣服，再把衣服晾在陽光下曬乾。）
She goes to the gym twice a week to keep fit, usually on Tuesday and Thursday evenings.（她一周去兩次健身房健身，通常是周二和周四晚上。）
The young scientist has made an important discovery in the field of environmental science.（這位年輕的科學家在環境科學領域有了一項重要的發現。）
The chemist at the local pharmacy told me how to take this medicine correctly.（當地藥局的藥劑師告訴我這款藥的正確服用方法。）
The cashier at the bakery gave me too much change, so I went back to return it.（麵包店的收銀員多找了我零錢，我便回去還給了她。）
The lights in our living room don’t work, so we need to call an electrician to fix them.（我們客廳的燈壞了，得找一位電工來修理。）
The receptionist at the company asked me to fill in a form before I met the manager.（這家公司的接待員讓我先填寫表單，再去見經理。）

items.chinese: 電視節目主持人；電視主播
items.example: The young TV presenter has become very popular because of her lively and humorous hosting style.（這位年輕的電視節目主持人因活潑幽默的主持風格走紅。）
We need to replace the old windows with double-glazed ones to keep the house warm in winter.（我們得把舊窗戶換成雙層玻璃的，這樣冬天房子裡會更暖和。）
My cat has been sick for two days, so I will take her to the vet this afternoon.（我的貓病了兩天，今天下午我要帶牠去看獸醫。）

items.chinese: 房產中介；不動產經紀人（英式）
items.example: We asked an estate agent to help us find a suitable apartment near the school.（我們委託了一位房產中介，幫我們找一間學校附近的合適公寓。）
The sink in the kitchen is leaking, so we have to call a plumber to fix it immediately.（廚房的水龍頭漏水了，我們得馬上找水電工來修理。）
This modern museum was designed by a world-famous architect from France.（這座現代美術館是由一位法國的世界著名建築師設計的。）
We hired an interior designer to decorate our new house, and she made a perfect design plan for us.（我們聘請了一位室內設計師裝修新家，她為我們做了一份極佳的設計方案。）

items.chinese: 脆的、清爽的；（英式）洋芋片
items.example: These fresh carrots are very crisp, and they taste great when eaten raw.（這些新鮮胡蘿蔔很脆，生吃味道很棒。）
She has always wanted to own a small café in the neighbourhood, and she finally did it last year.（她一直想在社區裡擁有一家小咖啡館，去年終於實現了。）
Summer in Wuhan is very hot and humid, and people often feel sticky all over.（武漢的夏天悶熱潮濕，人們經常覺得渾身黏膩。）
It’s not fair to judge someone only by their first impression; you need to know them better.（只靠第一印象評價一個人是不公平的，你需要更瞭解他們。）
Before you sign the tenancy agreement, make sure you understand all the terms about the rent and deposit.（簽訂租賃合約前，務必瞭解所有關於租金和押金的條款。）
The local government has taken many measures to solve the problem of urban waterlogging in Wuhan in recent years.（當地政府近年來採取了許多措施，解決武漢的城市內澇問題。）
The landlord told the tenants that the rent would increase by 10% next month.（房東告訴租客們，房租將在下個月上調 10%。）
The soldiers stand sentry at the camp gate 24 hours a day to ensure the safety of the camp.（士兵們全天 24 小時在營地門口站崗，確保營地安全。）
The water from the kitchen sink is slow to drain, so we need to clean the pipe.（廚房水槽的下水很慢，我們需要清理一下水管。）
It’s raining outside, so we can’t hang the clothes out to dry—let’s use the tumble dryer instead.（外面在下雨，衣服晾不了，我們用烘衣機吧。）
The manager needs to handle the problem carefully because it affects everyone on the team.（經理需要謹慎處理這個問題，因為它影響到團隊裡的每個人。）

items.chinese: 萬物有靈且美（經典譯法）；大大小小的所有生物
items.example: All creatures great and small is one of my favourite books, as it tells many warm stories about animals and vets.（《萬物有靈且美》是我最喜歡的書之一，裡面講述了許多關於動物和獸醫的溫暖故事。）

items.chinese: 免費巴士乘坐；免費巴士行程
items.example: Students can get a free bus ride with their student ID cards.（學生憑學生證可免費乘坐巴士。）
We often watch films together on Friday nights.（我們經常在週五晚上一起看電影。）

items.chinese: 激勵員工；調動員工積極性
items.example: The manager uses praise and opportunities to motivate staff.（這位經理用表揚和機會來激勵員工。）
Please let me know your available time for the meeting.（請告知我你參加會議的空閒時間。）
I need to make an appointment with the dentist because my tooth hurts.（我牙齒疼，需要和牙醫預約掛號。）
My hairdresser suggested a new hairstyle that suits me well.（我的美髮師建議了一個很適合我的新髮型。）
The company gave all employees a Christmas bonus this year.（公司今年給所有員工發了聖誕獎金。）
We spent three days exploring Amsterdam and visited the Van Gogh Museum.（我們在阿姆斯特丹遊覽了三天，還參觀了梵高博物館。）
Many tourists go to Iceland to experience its unique natural beauty.（很多遊客前往冰島體驗其獨特的自然美景。）

items.chinese: 加勒比地區；加勒比海（地區）
items.example: They spent their summer holiday on a beautiful beach in the Caribbean.（他們在加勒比地區一個美麗的海灘度過暑假。）
My colleague and I are co-developing the backend API for the Overseas Headquarters’ new platform.（我和同事正在為海外總部的新平台聯合開發後端接口。）
She has a bad sore throat, so she can’t sing in the school concert tonight.（她喉嚨很痛，所以今晚不能在學校音樂會上唱歌了。）
He felt fine after the short rest, but he was fined 100 yuan for parking in the wrong place.（短暫休息後他感覺不錯，但因停車不當被罰款 100 元。）
We will have a team meeting tomorrow to discuss how to improve our work efficiency.（我們明天將開團隊會議，討論如何提高工作效率。）
The food in that restaurant was cold and tasted disgusting, so we left without finishing it.（那家餐廳的食物是涼的，嘗起來令人作嘔，所以我們沒吃完就離開了。）
She practices English pronunciation every morning by listening to tapes and repeating after them.（她每天早上通過聽錄音並跟讀來練習英語發音。）
This new machine is very efficient—it can finish the work of three old machines in half the time.（這台新機器非常高效，它能在一半時間內完成三台舊機器的工作。）
I called the store’s customer service to ask about the return policy, and they answered all my questions patiently.（我致電商店客服詢問退貨政策，他們耐心地回答了我所有的問題。）
She worked hard for two years and finally got a promotion to manager; meanwhile, the store is running a big promotion this weekend.（她努力工作了兩年，終於晉升為經理；與此同時，這家商店本周末正在開展大型促銷活動。）
It’s important to buy health insurance to cover unexpected medical expenses.（購買健康保險以應對意外醫療費用是很重要的。）
They founded a startup company focused on green energy, and it has grown quickly in the past year.（他們創立了一家專注於綠色能源的初創公司，過去一年裡發展迅速。）
The comedian used a homophonic pun in his show: “I’m reading a book about anti-gravity—it’s impossible to put down!”（這位喜劇演員在表演中用了諧音雙關：「我在讀一本關於反重力的書，根本放不下！」）
Our company moved to an open-plan office last month, which makes it easier to communicate with colleagues.（我們公司上個月搬到了開放式辦公室，這讓與同事溝通變得更方便了。）
The manager has a private office where she can hold important meetings without being disturbed.（經理有一間私人辦公室，她可以在那裡舉行重要會議而不被打擾。）
Many law firms prefer cellular offices because they offer more privacy for client meetings.（許多律師事務所更喜歡單間式辦公室，因為它們能為客戶會面提供更多私密性。）
Freelancers and remote workers often choose co-working spaces to avoid working alone at home.（自由職業者和遠距工作者經常選擇聯合辦公空間，以避免在家獨自工作。）
The company introduced a hot-desking office policy to make better use of space and encourage collaboration.（這家公司推出了輪用桌辦公室政策，以更好地利用空間並鼓勵合作。）
